title: Supplier
description: One supplier — a document in the `suppliers` collection of the local MongoDB database `markovathon`. Seeded from /backend/data/seed/suppliers.json. Mongo's `_id` is deliberately not permitted here: see contracts/storage.md.

single_source.description: True if no alternate supplier exists for this part — raises severity.

compliance_status.description: Drives the status dot color on the frontend supplier board.

location.description: Matched against event.affected_location by substring/exact match. No geocoding.

downstream_dependents.description: Supplier ids that depend on this one. This is what makes cascading effects work.
